evidence: No GA4, GTM, Cloudflare Web Analytics, Plausible or Clarity marker found in source or public production HTML. The repository has an optional Lovable error-reporting hook, not a conversion analytics integration. Hosting dashboard injection settings remain unverified.
recommendation: One lightweight GA4 gtag integration after owner provides property ID and privacy/consent decision; no GTM or additional marketing stack unless already managed by the owner. Recheck production hosting injection immediately before enabling to avoid duplicates.
ownerDecisionsRequired: Confirm existing analytics/property and hosting injection configuration.
Provide the chosen measurement/property ID (none invented).
Confirm applicable privacy notice, consent behavior and retention settings before any tracking starts.
Decide whether browser-widget booking confirmation is sufficient reporting or a trusted webhook is required.

events.name: consultation_cta_click
events.trigger: User activates an actual consultation link; informational-to-commercial links are a separate navigation step.

events.name: lead_submission_success
events.trigger: Server confirms Google Sheets append; honeypot pseudo-success must not count. Deduplicate per submission.

events.name: scheduling_opened
events.trigger: First trusted Calendly page-view message from the owned iframe, after origin/source validation. Inserting a script/iframe or clicking an external link is not proof of successful opening.

events.name: scheduling_event_selected
events.trigger: Only a documented, trusted Calendly selection event supported by the integration. Do not infer from a CTA click.
events.status: DEFER until supported event semantics are verified

events.name: booking_confirmed
events.trigger: Trusted calendly.event_scheduled message from https://calendly.com and the exact owned iframe, once per inquiry. Label evidence browser_widget; server/webhook confirmation is a distinct stronger assurance.

events.name: phone_click
events.trigger: Activation of tel: link; measures click intent, not a completed call.

events.name: listing_inquiry
events.trigger: Activation of listing inquiry CTA. Successful submission separately emits lead_submission_success with controlled source listing.

events.name: payment_success
events.trigger: No event: payment-provider verification is unavailable. Browser navigation, inquiry and booking do not establish payment.

privacy: Never send name, email, telephone number, message, notes, budget, location, financing, Calendly event/invitee URI, or booking receipt.
Use pathname only. Do not collect URL query or fragment; a page_location override must omit prefill/tracking data that could contain PII.
Referrers limited to origin or approved source category, never arbitrary full URLs.
No advertising features, cross-site IDs or automatic enhanced form measurement by default.
Use an explicit allowlist payload adapter; do not serialize FormData, server responses or DOM text.
Do not use the booking receipt as an analytics lead ID. No lead identifier is needed for this first implementation.
funnel: Payment status only with future provider confirmation

rates.leadSubmissionRate: successful lead submissions / consultation CTA sessions (also report per session)
rates.bookingRate: trusted booking_confirmed / successful lead submissions; external-tab bookings may be unobserved

validationPlan: Use mocked analytics sink and synthetic fixtures; assert forbidden fields never appear.
Verify one event per user action and no success event on validation/server errors or honeypot.
Reject untrusted origin and wrong iframe messages; do not count scheduling CTA as booking.
Use analytics debug mode only after owner configuration and consent decision.
